description: React component for the main dashboard page of the application, managing state, sidebar navigation, connection to Jira and Confluence, and rendering relevant components based on connection status.

methods.name: handleConnect
methods.description: Handles the connection to Jira or Confluence, simulating API calls and updating state with mock data.

methods.name: getSectionTitle
methods.description: Returns the title for the dashboard section based on connection status.

methods.name: getSectionSubtitle
methods.description: Returns the subtitle for the dashboard section based on connection status.
